author: Aoimi
quote: Terrible story of the game, and it does feel I was arguing with my ex virtually on this game, and it felt i was doing work on a virtual. There is no story; it feels so bland. There is no story that can give us a message. It was more about working for your girlfriend, and the girlfriend can sleep with another guy. This feels like an NTR game. The guy goes to work, and the girl can just sleep and F%$$%K another dude.

author: Aoimi
quote: Great game; it does remind me of my childhood. And especially the story. Keep it up, Nintendo. Make games with great stories, and make us feel the magic of this fantasy adventure in The Legend of Zelda.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
